text:
sasha: heads up — new model candidate (atlas-lite-7B) landed in model-registry. Need quantization plan + calibration checklist. goal: ~2x token cost reduction vs fp16, regression <=1% on our convo/summarization evals. who can take lead?
ethan: I can start. prefer to run int8 symmetric as baseline then try fp8 hybrid if quality dips.
li: we should surface per-layer sensitivity first. quick script:
li: ```bash
python tools/quant_sensitivity.py --model atlas-lite-7B --samples 500 --batch 8 --out sensitivities.csv
```
li: that gives layer-wise RMSE / KL scores. sort by impact and consider preserving top-k layers in fp16.
sasha: +1. for calibration, recommend two passes: 1) activation calibration (representative dataset, ~2k sequences), 2) eval on heldout prompts (n=500).
ethan: for gguf export, config I use:
ethan: ```json
{ "quant_type": "int8_sym", "per_channel": true, "calib_samples": 2048, "preserve_layers": [0,1,2] }
```
ethan: will try symmetric int8 first. if summarization dev metric drops >0.8% then try fp8 hybrid: attention/project layers fp8, rest int8.
natalie: timeline? we have a demo next Tue — want a canary by Mon EOD.
ethan: schedule: sensitivity run (today), int8 calib (tomorrow morning), eval pass (tomorrow afternoon), fp8 hybrid only if int8 fails.
calib-bot: queued job 4267: sensitivity-run atlas-lite-7B (500 samples). ETA ~12m.
li: quick checklist for bring-up (short):
li: - run sensitivities (save CSV)
li: - choose preserve set (top 3 by impact)
li: - run activation-only calibration (2k samples)
li: - export gguf/int8 artifacts with metadata (commit hash + quant config)
li: - run full eval suite (conv, summarization, embeddings if used)
li: - compare token latency and cost per 1M tokens vs fp16 baseline
li: - smoke deploy to staging, run A/B on small traffic (5%)
li: - flag for rollback if >1% regression or 10% tail-latency increase
sasha: adding a cost/latency note: expected raw throughput ~+18% tokens/sec for int8 on our A100 pool, cost ~48% of fp16 in current infra (with batching). numbers vary by sequence length.
ethan: sample eval diff (int8 vs fp16):
ethan: ```
metric,samples,fp16,int8,delta
conv_acc,1200,0.842,0.835,-0.0083
sum_rouge,500,0.672,0.665,-0.0104
```
ethan: borderline on summarization — might need preserve layer 4 or switch its matmul to fp16.
natalie: if we do fp8 hybrid, what infra dependencies?
li: fp8 requires kernel support in our runtime (we have experimental fp8 kernels on runtime-v2). need to mark model as "requires-runtime-v2" in metadata and validate fallback to int8 if runtime not available.
sasha: ops note: include automatic fallback policy in rollout: prefer runtime-v2, else serve int8 variant; track per-route regressions.
ethan: plan to push initial int8 gguf artifact to staging branch: refs/quant/atlas-lite-7B/int8-v1 by EOD tomorrow.
li: small tip — use stratified sample for calibration (mix of short/long prompts), avoids biasing KV cache distribution.
sasha: OK sounds good. ethan take lead and post artifacts + eval CSVs here. I'll coordinate canary with ops. :thumbsup:
